arguments.assumptions: Explicit FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS scenario assumptions, split-adjusted for comparison with the 2026-09-18 split-adjusted close. Reported first-half FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85 (Q1 $2.39 plus Q2 $2.46) on separately reported diluted-share bases. Thus residual EPS assumptions for Q3+Q4 are $3.15/$5.15/$7.15 in bear/base/bull respectively; this is a constant-share approximation, not addition of actual future diluted EPS. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP gross margin +/-50bp and $9.2bn GAAP opex, with no China Data Center compute revenue assumed. Bear tests a material Q3/Q4 demand or mix/margin shortfall and/or multiple compression; base assumes Q3 guidance and continued demand roughly support the residual; bull assumes Q3 at/above guidance plus sustained ramp and a higher multiple. P/E bands 20x/25x/30x are scenario inputs, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.

cases.rationale: EPS is $3.15 above reported H1; tests a sharp deceleration versus the Q3 outlook through lower demand/mix or margin, alongside 20x multiple stress.
EPS is $5.15 above reported H1; assumes Q3 guidance and continued demand durability support FY completion, with 25x assumed multiple.
EPS is $7.15 above reported H1; assumes Q3 upside and sustained platform ramp/demand into Q4, with 30x assumed multiple.
